```powershell
Write-Output '=== WHERE THE DISTRICT LIVES 390 - RE-FILE AFTER EDITOR-OPEN DEFER: job 386 deferred with the editor open; this is its re-file. THE OTHER TWO MAPS, AND THE SOURCE ROAD IN (Job 382 stands as the record: VEILDistrict holds 44 actors and zero District-class actors among them, so the district actor the seating jobs hunted is not placed in the district map at all. Job 377 census stands beside it: StreamingLevelNames in no map, OMNIWorld named only inside its own map. If the district is not placed in VEILDistrict, it is placed in one of the other two maps, or it enters play from source at runtime - the GameMode stands read spawning actors at BeginPlay and the world builder stands in the same source tree. THIS JOB, merged base at D VEIL-OMNI, no edits anywhere: one, census OMNIWorld and VEILWorld exactly as job 382 censused VEILDistrict - load each map, print the actor count and every District-class actor with its streaming level names property read through the property API, errors verbatim, class defaults beside the instances. Two, print from source every SpawnActor line and every line carrying District in the GameMode source and the WorldBuilder source, with file names and line numbers. Three, print the verdict shape: which map, if any, holds a placed district actor, and whether the source spawns one at runtime.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 8) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 15; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'EDITOR STILL OPEN after 2 min - job deferred.'; Write-Output 'JOB 390 DEFERRED'; return }
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$uproj = "$base\VEIL.uproject"
$cmdexe = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: MAP CENSUS - OMNIWorld ---'
$pyA = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$outA = "$base\Saved\phi_seat390_omniworld.txt"
$pyA = $pyA.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$outA'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_seat390_omniworld.py" -Value $pyA -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item $outA -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_seat390_omniworld.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\seat390_omniworld.log"
if (Test-Path $outA) { Get-Content $outA | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO SEAT390 OMNIWORLD OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\seat390_omniworld.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1B: MAP CENSUS - VEILWorld ---'
$pyB = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$outB = "$base\Saved\phi_seat390_veilworld.txt"
$pyB = $pyB.Replace('OUTFILE', "'$outB'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_seat390_veilworld.py" -Value $pyB -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item $outB -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $cmdexe $uproj -run=pythonscript -script="$base\Saved\phi_seat390_veilworld.py" -unattended -nopause -nosplash *> "$base\Saved\seat390_veilworld.log"
if (Test-Path $outB) { Get-Content $outB | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO SEAT390 VEILWORLD OUTPUT FILE'; Select-String -Path "$base\Saved\seat390_veilworld.log" -Pattern 'Error|Traceback|Exception' | Select-Object -Last 6 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: SOURCE ROAD - GAMEMODE AND WORLDBUILDER ---'
$patSpawn = -join ([char[]](83,112,97,119,110,65,99,116,111,114))
$srcFiles = Get-ChildItem "$base\Source" -Recurse -Filter '*.cpp' -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -like '*GameMode*' -or $_.Name -like ('*WorldBuilde' + [char]114 + '*') }
if (-not $srcFiles) { Write-Output 'NO GAMEMODE OR WORLDBUILDER SOURCE FILE FOUND' }
foreach ($f in $srcFiles) {
  Write-Output ("SOURCE FILE: " + $f.FullName)
  Select-String -Path $f.FullName -Pattern $patSpawn | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ($f.Name + ' ' + $_.LineNumber + ': ' + $_.Line.Trim()) }
  Select-String -Path $f.FullName -Pattern 'District' | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ($f.Name + ' ' + $_.LineNumber + ': ' + $_.Line.Trim()) }
}
Write-Output '--- SECTION 3: RUNTIME SPAWN VERDICT COUNT ---'
$spawnDistrict = 0
foreach ($f in $srcFiles) {
  $both = Select-String -Path $f.FullName -Pattern $patSpawn | Where-Object { $_.Line -match 'District' }
  if ($both) { $spawnDistrict += $both.Count }
}
Write-Output ("PHI SEAT390 SOURCE LINES CARRYING BOTH SPAWN AND DISTRICT: " + $spawnDistrict)
Write-Output 'PHI SEAT390 VERDICT SHAPE: map verdicts stand in the section 1 payload prints; the runtime spawn count stands on the line above.'
Write-Output 'JOB 390 DONE'
```
